2024
 Neutral Citation No. 2024:Mphc-Jbp:55586

 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pramod Kumar Agrawal

On The 12th Of November, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 46470 of 2024
 Jamuna Kol
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Vinod Kumar Tiwari - Advocate for the applicant.
 Smt. Ranjana Agnihotri - Deputy Government Advocate for th
 Order

This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS/ 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.10/2019 registered at Police Station - Gadhwa, District Singrauli (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Section 376(1) of IPC.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that earlier present applicant has been enlarged on regular bail by the co-ordinate Bench vide order dated 29/06/2021 passed in M.Cr.C. No.
37057/2020 but on 23/08/2024 he could not appear before the court therefore, court has issued arrest warrant and now he is in custody since 3/10/2024.
He shall abide all the conditions imposed upon him.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.
3. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant.
Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 483 of BNSS/ 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant stands allowed.

5. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a Jamuna Kol vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128218752/
1 condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
